notes.title: Cinco De Mayo Contest ! Win $300 USD.
notes.content:
Play El Taco Diablo and reach the #1 spot.
If you have the best score (time alive) on May 5, 2019 at (5pm EST/ 2pm PST) then you are the winner.

Rules: 
1. No Cheating! Video of the run is required. Join out Discord channel (https://discord.gg/RrhPcvt) and post your score and video for verification by peers and developer.

2. Using obvious major bugs to your advantage is not allowed. Developer has final say what is considered an obvious major bug. 
(Major is consider a bug that changes the gameplay somehow)

3. No developer of El Taco Diablo or person related to the developer is allowed to win the contest, they can however compete.

Winnings will be sent using PAYPAL shortly after competition has ended.

notes.title: First Patch
notes.content:
Hi Everyone

I have applied a small update to the game to address some of the early issues that I have noticed players having with the game.

[list]
[*] [b]Made the green hit locations on the UFO's easier to see.[/b]
Hopefully making the game less confusing at the start, I will monitor this and see if it's still an issue after the new changes.

[*][b]UI should now be a bit easier to read.[/b]
Made the background for all yellow text a lot darker for readability.
[/list]
